Adds a complete Simplified Chinese interface locale covering all 2120 keys
present in the English source locale across 12 namespaces, and exposes it in
Preferences -> Regional & Language -> Language.

This builds on the initial zh_CN translation from #77 by @tksmashi, preserving
those entries and completing the keys added since -- including the celestial
(solar-system / planetarium) namespace, which did not exist when #77 was opened.

- frontend/src/i18n/locales/zh/*.json: 12 new locale files
- frontend/src/i18n/config.js: register zh in the i18next resources
- frontend/src/components/settings/preferences-form.jsx: add zh_CN to languageOptions

No backend change is needed: language is an unconstrained string preference and
the frontend already derives the i18next code from the stored value.

Co-authored-by: tksmashi <38005216+tksmashi@users.noreply.github.com>

feat(i18n): translate inline default strings for Simplified Chinese

Many components call t('key', { defaultValue: 'English text' }) with keys that do
not exist in any locale file. i18next returns the inline defaultValue when a key
is missing, so those strings rendered in English no matter which language was
selected -- even with a complete zh locale.

This adds Chinese translations for 232 such keys, in the zh locale only.

English and the other locales are untouched and keep falling back to the inline
defaultValue exactly as before, so this commit cannot change their behaviour.

Areas covered include the admin System -> General page, the station identity and
location forms plus the setup wizard, the About page, the maintenance/service
control card, the Preferences section headings, map settings, waterfall FFT and
SDR panels, the orbital source tabs, and the dashboard hardware popovers.

fix(i18n): complete zh translations for the app settings page

The System -> General page (app-settings-form) stayed partly English even with
a complete zh locale, for two separate reasons:

1. Eight settings groups reference keys that exist in no locale file, e.g.
   app_settings.group_network, group_storage, group_logging, group_security,
   group_tracking, group_discovery, group_orbital_sync and group_celestial_sync.
   Their English text lives in the frontend as titleDefault/descriptionDefault,
   and zh only carried group_other. Add the 16 missing entries.

2. Each field description is supplied by the backend schema
   (backend/common/appsettings.py) as a plain English string with no i18n field,
   and the component rendered it verbatim. Derive a locale key from the field
   key (app_settings.field_<key>) and fall back to the backend text, so no
   backend change is needed and English plus the other locales are unaffected.
   Add the 16 corresponding zh entries.

The new unit test covers both paths: a translated description renders the
translation, and a missing one falls back to the backend text rather than
exposing a raw key.
